gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Tests for {@link RefinedSoundex#encode(String)}.

RefinedSoundex encodes a word to a phonetic key: the initial letter followed by digit codes for consonant so
ADDED i2: Verifies that the encoding is case-insensitive: the same word in lower-case and upper-case must produce identical Refined Soundex codes.

ADDED i3: Verifies Refined Soundex codes for every word in the classic pangram "The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy dogs".

Each assertion message names the input
ADDED i4: Regression test for CODEC-56: the shared {@link RefinedSoundex#US_ENGLISH} static instance must produce the same result as a per-test instance.
